components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Teal CTA button for single primary page/modal actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #115E59; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.25); }

components.name: Conversion Accent Button
components.description: High-impact Coral CTA button paired strictly with dark Slate 800 text for WCAG AA contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background-color: #FF6B6B; color: #1E293B; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background-color: #EE5A5A; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.description: Neutral surface button with 1px Slate 200 border for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #1E293B; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F8FAFC; border-color: #CBD5E1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0F766E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.2); }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: 40px height form input with Slate 200 hairline border and Teal focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search city, subdivision, or project..." />
components.css: .ds-input { background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #1E293B; height: 40px; width: 280px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0F766E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge (Available)
components.description: Semantic status pill with indicator dot for active/verified inventory.
components.css: .ds-badge-available { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background-color: #ECFDF5; color: #15803D; border: 1px solid #A7F3D0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #10B981; }

narrative.northStar: Soft Minimalist SaaS & Architectural Real Estate Ledger
narrative.overview: Visual hierarchy is built through generous whitespace, crisp 1px hairline borders (#E2E8F0), and typographic contrast rather than heavy gradients, drop shadows, or ornamental chrome. High-contrast primary ink (#1E293B) on a cool alabaster ground (#F8FAFC) reduces eye strain across dense broker/agent property ledgers, cadastral map studios, and public discovery views.
keyCharacteristics: Strict 8-point spatial grid with 8px default border radius
Primary Spruce Teal (#0F766E) and high-contrast Conversion Coral (#FF6B6B with #1E293B ink)
Inter + JetBrains Mono typographic pairing for architectural and financial precision
44px minimum touch targets and isolated z-index: 0 map canvases

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Coral Rule
rules.body: Never pair #FFFFFF text with #FF6B6B backgrounds. Coral backgrounds must use #1E293B text for WCAG AA compliance.

rules.name: The Single Primary CTA Rule
rules.body: Each view or modal footer may display at most one solid Primary (#0F766E) action button; secondary actions use outline/ghost variants.

rules.name: The Map Isolation Rule
rules.body: All map canvases (Google Maps, Leaflet, subdivision vector editors) must remain isolated at z-index: 0 so map panes never overlap headers, drawers, or modals.

dos: Do use multiples of 8px for spacing and 8px (rounded-lg) as the default component radius.
Do use JetBrains Mono (font-mono tabular-nums) for PHP prices, lot areas (sqm), and coordinates.
Do pair focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/20 focus-visible:border-primary on all interactive controls.
donts: Don't write arbitrary pixel utilities like p-[13px], gap-[19px], or text-[15px].
Don't introduce off-token hex colors outside DESIGN.md Section 2.
Don't mount a Leaflet or Google Maps canvas without isolation: isolate and z-index: 0.
Don't ship continuous animations without prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.
